system: You are a helpful assistant. Notes and summaries can drift from what they summarise. Before you rely on any specific (a number, a condition, who is responsible, what applies to whom), check it against the source document itself; where the two differ, the source governs.
message:
Earlier you read the document below and made these notes on it:

<notes>
Foundry Yard Workspace membership (from 1 July 2026). Plans, ex-VAT: Hot Desk £180 a month (weekdays 08:00–20:00, any free desk); Dedicated Desk £320 (own desk, lockable pedestal, 24/7); Private Office for 2–6 people from £1,150 (24/7); Day Pass £25 (weekdays 09:00–17:30). Monthly plans renew on the 1st and need 30 days' written notice to end; private offices have a six-month minimum. Meeting room credits are 6 hours a month on Hot Desk, 8 on Dedicated Desk and 12 per person for Private Offices, with any unused credit rolling over to the next month; extra time is £25 an hour, booked in 30-minute slots. Members can bring two guests at a time free for up to four hours, signed in and accompanied; longer stays or desk use need a Day Pass. Members can register Foundry Yard as their company's registered office or trading address, and mail handling is included (no parcels over 60 × 40 × 40 cm). You get 100 free black-and-white prints a month, then 5p (colour 20p). Drinks are free; take calls in the phone booths (45 minutes max), not the Library. Fobs are personal (£20 to replace). Members are liable for their guests' damage. Dogs are welcome on Fridays. Non-payment over 14 days or serious breaches can end membership.
</notes>

Here is the document itself, for reference:

<document>
FOUNDRY YARD WORKSPACE — MEMBERSHIP AGREEMENT: PLAN TERMS AND HOUSE RULES (effective 1 July 2026)

1. Plans and fees (excluding VAT). • Hot Desk: £180 per month. Access Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 20:00, to any unreserved desk in the open-plan area. • Dedicated Desk: £320 per month. Your own desk with a lockable pedestal; 24/7 access with your key fob. • Private Office (2–6 people): from £1,150 per month; 24/7 access. • Day Pass: £25 per day, Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 17:30.

2. Term and notice. Monthly plans renew automatically on the 1st of each month. Either party may end a monthly plan by giving 30 days' written notice by email. Private Office agreements have a minimum term of six months.

3. Meeting room credits. Each plan includes monthly meeting room credits: Hot Desk 4 hours; Dedicated Desk 8 hours; Private Office 12 hours per person. Credits are allocated on the 1st of each month and expire at the end of that month; unused credits do not roll over and cannot be exchanged for a refund. Additional meeting room time is charged at £25 per hour. Bookings are made in the Foundry app in 30-minute slots.

4. Guests. Members may bring up to two guests at a time without charge, for meetings of up to four hours. All guests must be signed in at reception and must be accompanied by the host member at all times. Guests staying longer than four hours, or using a desk to work, must buy a Day Pass.

5. Business address and post. Members may register Foundry Yard as their company's registered office or trading address only if they hold a Dedicated Desk or Private Office plan and have been a member for at least three continuous months. Mail handling for all plans is included; parcels larger than 60 × 40 × 40 cm will not be accepted.

6. Printing. Each member receives 100 black-and-white pages per month; additional pages cost 5p (black-and-white) or 20p (colour).

7. Kitchen and quiet areas. Tea, coffee and filtered water are free. Phone calls are not permitted in the Library quiet zone; use the phone booths, which may be used for up to 45 minutes at a time.

8. Security. Key fobs are personal and must not be lent. A replacement fob costs £20. CCTV operates in all common areas.

9. Damage and liability. Members are responsible for damage caused by them or their guests. Foundry Yard is not responsible for personal belongings, except where loss is caused by its negligence.

10. Pets. Well-behaved dogs are permitted on Fridays only, on a lead in common areas, and not in the kitchen.

11. Termination for breach. Foundry Yard may suspend or end a membership immediately for non-payment of more than 14 days, or for serious or repeated breaches of these house rules.
</document>

A few questions from someone who needs to act on this:
1. I'm on the Hot Desk plan and need 5 hours of meeting rooms this month (no credit left over from before). Will it all be covered by my plan?
2. I only used 3 of my Dedicated Desk meeting-room hours in September. Can I use the 5 unused hours in October?
3. How much does a Dedicated Desk cost per month?
4. I joined on the Hot Desk plan two weeks ago. Can I make Foundry Yard my company's registered office?
response:
Checking against the agreement itself, my earlier notes were wrong on three points: Hot Desk credits, rollover, and the registered-office conditions.

**1. Not all of it.** The Hot Desk plan includes **4 hours** of meeting room credit a month, not 6 as my notes said (Section 3). The 5th hour costs **£25 + VAT**. Bookings are made in the Foundry app in 30-minute slots.

**2. No.** Credits are allocated on the 1st of each month and **expire at the end of that month**. Unused credits don't roll over and can't be refunded (Section 3). My notes wrongly said they roll over. In October you get a fresh 8 hours, and the 5 unused September hours are gone.

**3. £320 per month, excluding VAT** (Section 1). That includes your own desk, a lockable pedestal and 24/7 fob access.

**4. No, not yet.** Registering Foundry Yard as your registered office or trading address requires **both** (Section 5):
- a Dedicated Desk or Private Office plan, and
- at least **three continuous months** of membership.

A Hot Desk plan doesn't qualify, however long you've been a member. My notes left out these conditions. Mail handling is included on all plans, including Hot Desk, so you can still receive post there.
